title: Check suite definition
description: The check catalogue, stored at checks/checks.json. Definitions only: what each check id means and whether a listing requires it. A check result belongs to the verification block on a product record.

required.description: true: no product is listed in any state without an answer of passed, or not_applicable with a reason. false: optional, and leaving it not_tested caps the listing at experimental.

automatable.description: Whether an automated smoke check can produce evidence for this check. Evidence is not a person's verification and never replaces one.
